description: Billing policy knobs that are expected to change without a code release.

fields.description: Grant welcome credits when a team completes its billing profile.
fields.label: Grant Welcome Credits

fields.description: Days a welcome credit stays usable. 0 means it never expires.
fields.label: Validity (Days)

fields.description: Amount granted per currency. A currency with no row gets no credits.
fields.label: Amounts

fields.description: Days after an invoice opens before it falls due.
fields.label: Due Days

fields.description: Warn a team once forecast spend reaches this much of its cap.
fields.label: Spend Warning At

fields.description: Days past due to retry payment on, comma separated.
fields.label: Retry Days

fields.description: Days past due before a subscription is suspended.
fields.label: Suspend After (Days)

fields.description: Days past due before a subscription is terminated.
fields.label: Terminate After (Days)

fields.description: How long a cohort projection may be expected to take before it is refused. This is a production safety limit: raising it is how the bound stops bounding.
fields.label: Projection Budget (Seconds)
Offer Another Rail After a Terminal Decline
fields.description: When a card is finally refused, offer the customer the other gateway once, amount prefilled. Ambiguous failures (timeouts, abandoned 3DS) never fall back whatever this says. Which gateway is primary per currency is the Default flag on Payment Gateway Currency, so it stays in one place.
Output GST rate put on a new Indian team's tax profile.
fields.label: Default GST Rate
